positions.title: Technical Architect - Infrastructure
positions.description:
Technical Architect at Logic Information Systems. Duties include:
* Oracle Database Administration
* Linux/UNIX Administration
* AWS EC2 / Cloud Computing
* Middleware installation and configuration
* Oracle Retail software setup and configuration
* Oracle Database tuning
* Security
* Identity Management
* Cross platform database migrations
* Infrastructure process improvement

positions.title: Senior Oracle DBA
positions.description:
Senior Oracle DBA on the IT Operations Team at Quantum Retail. 

Installed, configured, and maintained Oracle database development environments in the cloud.

Provided support, maintenance to hosted Production environments.

Provided support, performance tuning to end users as needed.

Participated in Production support on-call rotation for DBA and Operations.

positions.title: Senior Oracle DBA/Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Oracle Database Administrator for the LATITUDE® Patient Management system (http://www.aboutlatitude.com/).

Oracle Database Administrator responsible for installation, maintenance, and support of Oracle database development, test and production environments.

Participated as a Senior Oracle DBA on the Latitude performance team responsible for managing the database environments as well as resolving performance issues as needed.

Participated with the infrastructure on-call rotation and managing of environment support requests.

positions.title: Senior Technical Consultant - Oracle Retail DBA
positions.description: Oracle Retail DBA with responsibility to install and configure Oracle Retail products for Mid-Market Retailers.

positions.title: Senior Consultant - Technical Services (DBA)
positions.description:
Involved with implementation and production support of Oracle Retail products.
Provided Oracle DBA support for development and production systems.

positions.title: System Analyst
positions.description:
Member of the Accenture Tech Team@Retek. Provided DB support and setup for custom development environments.

Provided custom development on RDM 9 & RDM 10 systems
